motto: Everything in the frame was computed. Nothing was downloaded.
compiled: at build time — this object was folded into the JavaScript bundle by Vite; no request fetched it

eras.name: The Seeding
eras.story: A single integer is spoken, and from it every future draw of fate is fixed: bullet spread, wind phase, the wear on every wall. The seed is small enough to write on a coin, and the coin is the whole world.
eras.source: src/engine/rng.ts — PCG32, the only randomness in the repository

eras.name: The Shaping
eras.story: The land rises as layered noise, then sixty-four seasons of rain are simulated in a single breath — hydraulic erosion carving valleys on the GPU before a single frame is drawn.

eras.name: The Raising
eras.story: Markets, cranes, the old fort — every wall lathed and lofted from arithmetic in eight parallel workshops. No mesh was ever imported; the town is an opinion held by code.

eras.name: The Peopling
eras.story: Twenty-four souls wake with the same body of laws as the player: they perceive, they choose, and they express their choices in the very same PlayerIntent the human's hands produce. Character is architecture.

eras.name: The Contest
eras.story: Three places — the market, the harbour, the fort — and two banners contending for them. History here is not stored on any server; it is recomputed, identically, wherever the chronicle is opened.
